bugFixes.title: Effects Motion Preference Override
bugFixes.description: Fixed critical issue where reveal() and ripple() effects were being disabled by CSS media queries even when JavaScript explicitly set respectMotionPreference: false
details: Added data-force-animation attribute to elements when motion preference should be ignored
Updated CSS @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) queries to exclude elements with data-force-animation
Fixed ripple effect to apply attribute to dynamically created ripple elements
Ensures showcase demo pages work correctly regardless of user's system motion preferences

bugFixes.title: Showcase Effects Pages Cleanup
bugFixes.description: Cleaned up effects showcase pages by removing references to obsolete overrideMotionPreference variable
details: Updated all showcase pages to use respectMotionPreference: false consistently
Fixed 14 remaining references across 3 showcase files
